   26 def independent_rank(values, labels, mutant=None):
   27     """Separate candidate enumeration and logaddexp formulation."""
   28     terms = []

  110         value, grad, _ = analytic_rank(scores.detach().double().cpu().tolist(),group.labels)

  126     def test_rank_reference_and_rejected_mutants(self):
  127         g = handmade_group("rank")
  128         labels = np.asarray(g.labels)
  129         rows = []
  130         for dtype in (torch.float64, torch.float32):
  131             for tag, values in (("unequal",np.sin(np.arange(378)*.7)*4), ("equal",np.zeros(378)),
  132                                 ("extreme",np.where(np.arange(378)%3,1000.,-1000.))):
  133                 x = torch.tensor(values,dtype=dtype,requires_grad=True)
  134                 actual = method.objectives(x,torch.tensor(labels,dtype=dtype))["rank_pos"]
  135                 gradient, = torch.autograd.grad(actual,x)
  136                 ref, grad, qgrad = analytic_rank(x.detach().tolist(),labels)
  137                 atol,rtol = (1e-12,1e-12) if dtype == torch.float64 else (ATOL,RTOL)
  138                 np.testing.assert_allclose(float(actual.detach()),ref,atol=atol,rtol=rtol)
  139                 np.testing.assert_allclose(gradient.numpy(),grad,atol=atol,rtol=rtol)
  140                 self.assertTrue(np.all(grad[labels.astype(bool)] <= 0))
  141                 self.assertTrue(np.all(grad[~labels.astype(bool)] >= 0))
  142                 for k,(a,b) in enumerate(PAIRS): self.assertAlmostEqual(grad[k],(qgrad[a][k]+qgrad[b][k])/28,places=12)
  143                 if tag == "unequal" and dtype == torch.float64:
  144                     for k in (0,1,53,97,377):
  145                         xp,xm=values.copy(),values.copy();xp[k]+=1e-5;xm[k]-=1e-5
  146                         fd=(analytic_rank(xp,labels)[0]-analytic_rank(xm,labels)[0])/2e-5
  235     def test_capture_restore_and_next_update(self):
  236         c=run.config();out=self.temporary();evidence={}
  237         current,history=handmade_group("current"),handmade_group("history")
  238         target=(3*np.sin(np.arange(1540)/7)).astype(np.float32)
  239         for arm in method.ARMS:

  241             method.update(model,optimizer,current,None,None,c,arm,1,1)
  242             for v in optimizer.state.values():v["step"].fill_(336)
  243             saved,rng,modes=state(model,optimizer),diag.rng_state(),[m.training for m in model.modules()]
  244             first=method.update(model,optimizer,current,history,target,c,arm,2,49)
  245             expected,expected_rng=state(model,optimizer),diag.rng_state()
  246             restore(model,optimizer,saved,rng,modes)
  247             memory=shared_memory(arm);memory.begin_stage(2)
  248             for _ in range(48):memory.draw()
  249             payload=memory.to_bytes();fit=[handmade_group(f"fit{i}") for i in range(48)]
  250             valid=[data.Group(g.uid,g.sellers,g.items) for g in [handmade_group(f"valid{i}") for i in range(40)]]
  251             capture=method.capture(model,optimizer,fit,memory,valid,c,arm,2,1,out,arm)
  252             result=data.read_json(out/capture["path"]);run.validate_diagnostic(result,arm)
  253             with diag.neutral(model):
  254                 raw=method.score(model,valid,c,arm)
  255                 np.testing.assert_array_equal(run.previous.array(out,result["valid_blind"],(40,378),np.float32),raw)
  256                 for role,gs in (("fit",fit),("cache",memory.reservoir.groups)):
  257                     np.testing.assert_array_equal(run.previous.array(out,result[role],(len(gs),3),np.float64),diag.metrics(gs,method.score(model,gs,c,arm)))
  258                 g=memory.reservoir.groups[0];live=record.reference(model,g,c);old=memory.tables[g.uid]
  259                 for key,seed in (("D0",None),("D1",data.seed_for(20261008,"ABC",2,g.uid,"diagnostic_regroup"))):
  260                     slots=record.assignment(g,seed)
  261                     error=(independent_pool(torch.from_numpy(live),slots,arm)-independent_pool(torch.from_numpy(old),slots,arm)).detach().numpy().astype(np.float64)
  262                     self.assertAlmostEqual(result["teacher_errors"][0][key],float(np.mean(error**2)),places=6)
  263             self.assertEqual(core.state_digest(saved),core.state_digest(state(model,optimizer)))
  264             self.assertEqual((rng,payload,modes),(diag.rng_state(),memory.to_bytes(),[m.training for m in model.modules()]))
  265             repeated=method.update(model,optimizer,current,history,target,c,arm,2,49)
  266             self.assertEqual(first,repeated);self.assertEqual(core.state_digest(expected),core.state_digest(state(model,optimizer)))
  267             self.assertEqual(expected_rng,diag.rng_state())
  268             meta={**method.metadata(arm),"rng":diag.rng_state(),"modes":[m.training for m in model.modules()]}
  269             with diag.neutral(model):before=method.restored_score(model,[current],c)
  270             for kind,opt in (("full",optimizer),("inference",None)):
  271                 p=out/(arm+kind+".pt");receipt=core.save_state(p,model,opt,meta)
  272                 model.training_identity={"arm":"incorrect"}
  273                 run.restore_point(p,receipt,model,opt,arm)
  274                 with diag.neutral(model):np.testing.assert_array_equal(before,method.restored_score(model,[current],c))
  275             wrong="H_pos" if arm=="S_pos" else "S_pos"
  276             with self.assertRaises(ValueError):method.bind(model,{**meta,"pooling":method.identity(wrong)})
  277             with self.assertRaises(ValueError):run.memory_from(payload,wrong)

  282     def test_stage_a_empty_cache(self):
  283         c=run.config();out=self.temporary();evidence={}
  284         fit=[handmade_group(f"A_fit{i}") for i in range(48)]
  285         valid=[data.Group(g.uid,g.sellers,g.items) for g in [handmade_group(f"blind{i}") for i in range(40)]]
  286         for arm in method.ARMS:

  288             method.update(model,optimizer,fit[0],None,None,c,arm,1,1)
  289             for value in optimizer.state.values():value["step"].fill_(48)

  292             self.assertEqual((empty.shape,empty.dtype),((0,378),np.dtype(np.float32)))
  293             with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"Scoring candidate differs"):

  296             row=data.read_json(out/capture["path"]);run.validate_diagnostic(row,arm)

  298             self.assertEqual((row["cache_ids"],row["cache_domains"],row["teacher_errors"]),([],[],[]))
  299             run.previous.array(out,row["cache"],(0,3),np.float64)
  300             run.previous.array(out,row["fit"],(48,3),np.float64)
  301             run.previous.array(out,row["valid_blind"],(40,378),np.float32)
  302             self.assertEqual(core.state_digest(saved),core.state_digest(state(model,optimizer)))
  303             self.assertEqual((rng,modes),(diag.rng_state(),[m.training for m in model.modules()]))
  304             # Reproduce the removed S dispatch failure without altering the frozen scorer.
  305             with diag.neutral(model),self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"need at least one array"):
  306                 record.score(model,[],c)
  307             evidence[arm]=dict(actual_optimizer_calls=1,synthetic_clock=48,
  308                 capture_populations=[48,0,40],empty_score_shape=[0,378],cache_metric_shape=[0,3],
  309                 state_unchanged=True,wrong_arm_rejected=True,old_empty_dispatch_failure_reproduced=True)
  310         self.evidence("stage_a_empty_cache",evidence)

  313         import step28_positive_ranking_verify as verify
  314         from types import SimpleNamespace
  315         process=mock.Mock(pid=413);process.cpu_affinity.return_value=[0];process.parents.return_value=[]
  316         sample={"apps":"", "free":31*1024, "host":80*2**30, "jobs":[], "allocated":0, "reserved":0}
  317         def query(args,**kwargs):
  318             return (sample["apps"] if "--query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory" in args
  319                     else f"0, handwritten-GPU, 32768, {sample['free']}, 1024")
  320         env={"CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES":"0","OMP_NUM_THREADS":"1","MKL_NUM_THREADS":"1",
  321              "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS":"1","TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM":"false"}
  322         with mock.patch.dict(os.environ,env),mock.patch.object(verify.psutil,"Process",return_value=process), \

  329              mock.patch.object(verify.torch.cuda,"memory_reserved",side_effect=lambda:sample["reserved"]):
  330             first=verify.native_preflight(False)
  331             self.assertEqual(first["compute_apps"],"");empty.assert_not_called()
  332             sample["apps"]="413, python, 512"
  333             with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"Resource gate failed"):
  334                 verify.native_preflight(False)
  335             second=verify.native_preflight(True)
  336             self.assertEqual(second["allowed_context_pid"],413);collect.assert_called_once();empty.assert_called_once()
  337             rejected=[]

  339                     ("host",72*2**30-1),("allocated",4),("reserved",4),
  340                     ("jobs",[SimpleNamespace(pid=415,info={"pid":415,"username":"same-user","cmdline":["step28_other.py"]})])):
  341                 previous=sample[key];sample[key]=value
  342                 with self.assertRaises(ValueError):verify.native_preflight(True)
  343                 sample[key]=previous;rejected.append(key)
  344             # Reach the real native entry's resource call, stopping before model loading/GPU work.
  345             class StopBeforeGPU(Exception):pass
  346             with mock.patch.object(verify,"native_preflight",side_effect=StopBeforeGPU) as entry:
  347                 for continuing,arm in ((False,"S_pos"),(True,"H_pos")):
  348                     with self.assertRaises(StopBeforeGPU):
  349                         verify.native(lambda:None,lambda *a,**k:None,None,None,arm,continuing=continuing)
  350                 self.assertEqual(entry.call_args_list,[mock.call(False),mock.call(True)])
  351         self.evidence("native_continuation_preflight",dict(first_strict=True,own_context_only_second=True,

  355     def test_dual_orchestration_and_joint_opening(self):
  356         root=self.temporary();groups={};metadata=[]
  357         for split,count in (("train",60),("development",20)):
  358             groups[split]=[]
  359             for d in "AB":
  360                 for i in range(count):
  361                     g=handmade_group(f"{d}_{split}_{i:02}")
  362                     metadata.append(dict(group_uid=g.uid,domain=d,split=split,group_index=i))
  363                     groups[split].append(g if split=="train" else data.Group(g.uid,g.sellers,g.items))
  364         loads,calls=[],[];c=run.config()
  365         _,split_expected=run.partition(groups,metadata,c)
  366         oldroot=root/"frozen_fixture"; (oldroot/"run/updates").mkdir(parents=True)
  367         data.write_json(oldroot/"run/partition.json",split_expected)
  368         tiny=tiny_model(); tinyopt=core.make_optimizer(tiny,c)
  369         fake_baseline={"initial_identity":{"model":core.state_digest(tiny.state_dict()),"adam":core.state_digest(tinyopt.state_dict())}}
  370         del tiny,tinyopt
  371         class Budget:
  372             phase="handwritten orchestration"
  373             def check(self,*args):pass
  374             def snapshot(self):return {}
  375         def load(cfg):
  376             loads.append("fresh");return tiny_model()
  377         def update(model,optimizer,current,history,target,cfg,arm,stage,step,check):
  378             self.assertTrue(current.uid.startswith("AB"[stage-1]+"_"))
  379             self.assertEqual(run.parent.adam_step(optimizer),(stage-1)*288+step-1)
  380             calls.append((arm,stage,step,current.uid,None if history is None else history.uid))
  381             if history:self.assertTrue(history.uid.startswith("A_"))
  382             t=(stage-1)*288+step
  383             for p in model.parameters():
  384                 optimizer.state[p]={"step":torch.tensor(float(t)),"exp_avg":torch.zeros_like(p),"exp_avg_sq":torch.zeros_like(p)}
  385             with torch.no_grad():model.head[2].bias.fill_(t*.001+method.ARMS.index(arm)*.3)
  386             row=dict(total=1.,encoder_lr=run.parent.stage_lr(step),head_lr=.001,**method.metadata(arm))
  387             for role,g in (("current",current),("history",history)):
  388                 if g is not None:
  389                     seed=data.seed_for(20260918,"ABC",stage,step,role,g.uid,"regroup")
  390                     row[role]=dict(supervised=1.,weighted=1. if role=="current" else .1,mse0=0.,mse1=None,distillation=0.,
  391                         supervised_contribution=1. if role=="current" else .1,teacher_contribution=0.,qualification_old_rank=False,
  392                         views=[dict(bce=.2,rank_pos=.3,rank_used=.3,hard=1.,total=1.) for _ in range(2)],
  393                         assignment_sha256=hashlib.sha256(record.assignment(g,seed).tobytes()).hexdigest())
  394             if history:row["total"]=1.1
  395             return row
  396         truth=np.asarray(handmade_group("geometry").labels);tables={}
  397         def reference(model,g,cfg,check=lambda:None):
  398             if g.uid not in tables:
  399                 slots=record.assignment(g)
  400                 lookup={p:k for k,p in enumerate(itertools.combinations(range(28),2))}
  401                 values=[]
  402                 for i,j in itertools.combinations(range(len(slots)),2):
  403                     a,b=sorted((int(slots[i]),int(slots[j])))
  404                     k=0 if a==b else lookup[a,b]
  405                     values.append((0 if a==b else truth[k]*3)+math.sin(i*.7+j*.3))
  406                 tables[g.uid]=np.asarray(values,np.float32)
  407             return tables[g.uid]+float(model.head[2].bias.detach())
  408         def score(model,gs,cfg,arm,check=lambda:None):
  409             if not gs:return production_score(model,gs,cfg,arm,check)
  410             return np.stack([method.account_logits(torch.from_numpy(reference(model,g,cfg)),record.assignment(g),arm).numpy() for g in gs]).astype(np.float32)
  411         production_score = method.score
  412         with mock.patch.object(run,"baseline_inputs",return_value=(fake_baseline,oldroot,{},{"public_inputs":{"handwritten":True}})), \
  413              mock.patch.object(run,"baseline_runs",side_effect=lambda:{a:(oldroot,{}, {}) for a in ("S","G_half")}), \

  425             data.write_json(root/"access.json",dict(train=0,valid=0,heldout=0,owners=0))

FILE scripts/step28_replay_diagnostics.py
    1 """Epoch diagnostics on current fit/cache and blind valid, without learner mutation."""
    2 from __future__ import annotations
    3 
    4 from contextlib import contextmanager
    5 import random
    6 from pathlib import Path
    7 from typing import Any, Callable
    8 
    9 import numpy as np
   10 
   11 import step28_record_replay as record
   12 import step28_bge_continual_run as previous
   13 
   14 parent, data = record.parent, record.data
   15 COLUMNS = ("map", "recall_at_5", "log_loss")
   16 
   17 
   18 def rng_state() -> dict:
   19     value = np.random.get_state()
   20     return {"torch": previous.rng_state(), "python": random.getstate(),
   21             "numpy": [value[0], value[1].tolist(), int(value[2]), int(value[3]), float(value[4])]}
   22 
   23 
   24 def restore_rng(state: dict) -> None:
   25     previous.restore_rng(state["torch"])
   26     random.setstate(data.tuple_state(state["python"]))
   27     n = state["numpy"]
   28     np.random.set_state((n[0], np.asarray(n[1], np.uint32), n[2], n[3], n[4]))
   29 
   30 
   31 @contextmanager
   32 def neutral(model: Any):
   33     """Restore individual modes and global RNGs even if a diagnostic fails."""
   34     import torch
   35     state, modes = rng_state(), [(m, m.training) for m in model.modules()]
   36     try:
   37         model.eval()
   38         with torch.inference_mode():
   39             yield
   40     finally:
   41         for module, mode in modes:
   42             module.training = mode
   43         restore_rng(state)
   44 
   45 
   46 def score(model: Any, groups: list, c: dict, arm: str, check: Callable) -> np.ndarray:
   47     if not groups:
   48         return np.empty((0, 378), np.float32)
   49     return (parent.ranking.score if arm == "LOGIT0.1" else record.score)(model, groups, c, check)
   50 
   51 
   52 def metrics(groups: list, values: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
   53     if not groups:
   54         return np.empty((0, len(COLUMNS)), np.float64)
   55     if any(g.labels is None for g in groups):
   56         raise ValueError("Only current authorized labelled groups may be scored")
   57     matrix, _ = parent.metrics.group_metrics(np.asarray([g.labels for g in groups], np.uint8), values)
   58     return matrix[:, [parent.metrics.COLUMNS.index(k) for k in COLUMNS]]
   59 
   60 
   61 def capture(model: Any, optimizer: Any, current: list, memory: Any, valid: list,
   62             c: dict, arm: str, order: str, stage: int, epoch: int, root: Path,
   63             point: str, check: Callable = lambda: None, scope: str = "ABC",
   64             table_diagnostic: Callable | None = None, score_fn: Callable | None = None,
   65             pooling_fn: Callable | None = None) -> dict:
   66     """Called by the actual training loop after every 48 updates; never loads labels."""
   67     import torch
   68     if epoch not in range(1, 7) or parent.adam_step(optimizer) != (stage-1)*288+epoch*48:
   69         raise ValueError("Diagnostic not at the registered epoch endpoint")
   70     if scope not in ("ABC", "AB") or len(current) != 48 or len(valid) != 20*len(scope) or any(g.labels is not None for g in valid):
   71         raise ValueError("Diagnostic fit/valid scope differs")
   72     cache = [] if memory is None else list(memory.reservoir.groups)
   73     if len(cache) != (0 if stage == 1 else 6):
   74         raise ValueError("Wrong surviving cache")
   75     before = memory.to_bytes() if memory is not None else None
   76     step_before = parent.adam_step(optimizer)
   77     origins = ({} if memory is None else memory.reference_origins if arm == "LOGIT0.1" else memory.origins)
   78     scorer, pool = score_fn or score, pooling_fn or record.account_logits
   79     with neutral(model):
   80         fit_values = metrics(current, scorer(model, current, c, arm, check))
   81         cache_scores = scorer(model, cache, c, arm, check)
   82         cache_values = metrics(cache, cache_scores)
   83         blind = scorer(model, valid, c, arm, check)
   84         errors = []
   85         for i, group in enumerate(cache):
   86             check()
   87             if arm == "LOGIT0.1":
   88                 e0 = cache_scores[i] - memory.references[group.uid]
   89                 errors.append({"uid": group.uid, "D0": float(np.mean(e0.astype(np.float64)**2)),
   90                                "D1": None, "residual_cross_mean": None, "residual_difference_mse": None})
   91             elif arm in ("C_cf", "C_perm"):
   92                 from step28_crossfit_retention import floor_loss
   93                 # The saved score is the actual FP32 A0 pooling result. No extra forward.
   94                 _, details = floor_loss(torch.from_numpy(cache_scores[i]), group, memory.tables[group.uid])
   95                 errors.append({"uid": group.uid, **details})
   96             else:
   97                 live = record.reference(model, group, c, check)
   98                 target = memory.tables[group.uid]
   99                 seeds = (None, data.seed_for(20261008, order, stage, group.uid, "diagnostic_regroup"))
  100                 residual = []
  101                 for seed in seeds:
  102                     slots = record.assignment(group, seed)
  103                     # Eval-only CPU pooling of the same FP32 tables; no model gradient.
  104                     view = "A0" if seed is None else "A1"
  105                     live_score = pool(torch.from_numpy(live), slots, group, view) if pooling_fn else pool(torch.from_numpy(live), slots)
  106                     teacher_score = pool(torch.from_numpy(target), slots, group, "teacher_"+view) if pooling_fn else pool(torch.from_numpy(target), slots)
  107                     residual.append((live_score-teacher_score).numpy().astype(np.float64))
  108                 e0, e1 = residual
  109                 errors.append({"uid": group.uid, "D0": float(np.mean(e0**2)), "D1": float(np.mean(e1**2)),
  110                                "residual_cross_mean": float(np.mean(e0*e1)),
  111                                "residual_difference_mse": float(np.mean((e1-e0)**2))})
  112                 if table_diagnostic is not None:
  113                     errors[-1].update(table_diagnostic(live, group, target))
  114     if (parent.adam_step(optimizer) != step_before
  115             or (memory.to_bytes() if memory is not None else None) != before):
  116         raise ValueError("Diagnostics changed optimizer step or bounded history")
  117     tag = f"{point}_epoch{epoch}"
  118     result = {"point": point, "order": order, "arm": arm, "stage": stage, "epoch": epoch,
  119               "stage_step": epoch*48, "adam_step": step_before, "seed": "s0", "metric_columns": list(COLUMNS),
  120               "fit_ids": [g.uid for g in current], "fit_domains": [order[stage-1]]*48,
  121               "cache_ids": [g.uid for g in cache], "cache_domains": [order[origins[g.uid]-1] for g in cache],
  122               "valid_ids": [g.uid for g in valid], "teacher_errors": errors,
  123               "mode": "A0_eval_no_autograd", "valid_labels_used": False,
  124               "fit": previous.save_array(root/(tag+"_fit.npy"), fit_values, root),
  125               "cache": previous.save_array(root/(tag+"_cache.npy"), cache_values, root),
  126               "valid_blind": previous.save_array(root/(tag+"_valid.npy"), blind, root)}
  127     path = root/(tag+".json")
  128     data.write_json(path, result)
  129     return data.record(path, root)
  130 
  131 
  132 def summary(values: np.ndarray, draws: np.ndarray) -> dict:
  133     estimates = values[draws].mean(axis=1)
  134     return {"mean": values.mean(axis=0).tolist(),
  135             "conditional_95pct_interval": np.quantile(estimates, [.025, .975], axis=0).T.tolist()}
  136

   27 def old_numerics() -> dict:
   28     # Literal settings of the SHA-bound historical LOGIT execute, lines 520--523.
   29     torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
   30     torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
   31     torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
   32     torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
   33     return observed()
   34

   36 def observed() -> dict:
   37     return {"deterministic_algorithms": torch.are_deterministic_algorithms_enabled(),
   38             "deterministic_warn_only": torch.is_deterministic_algorithms_warn_only_enabled(),
   39             "cuda_matmul_allow_tf32": torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32,
   40             "cudnn_allow_tf32": torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32,
   41             "cudnn_benchmark": torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark,
   42             "cublas_workspace_config": os.environ.get("CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG")}

   44 
   45 def cpu_copy(value):
   46     if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor):
   47         return value.detach().cpu().clone()
   48     if isinstance(value, dict):
   49         return {k: cpu_copy(v) for k, v in value.items()}
   50     if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
   51         return type(value)(cpu_copy(v) for v in value)
   52     return copy.deepcopy(value)

   55 def equal_state(left, right, counts, path="state"):
   56     if isinstance(left, torch.Tensor):
   57         if (left.dtype != right.dtype or left.shape != right.shape or
   58                 not torch.equal(left.contiguous().reshape(-1).view(torch.uint8),
